Modbus.Title: Daikin HomeHub EKRHH (Altherma, Modbus TCP)
Modbus.HintText: Daikin HomeHub EKRHH, use case 3 (Modbus for Daikin Altherma). Modbus TCP port 502. Set the unit ID (Channel) to the value configured in the ONECTA app. Raw values 32765/32766/32767 mean: waiting for value / unavailable / unsupported.

ModbusCmd.Title: IR21 Unit abnormality
ModbusCmd.HintText: 0: No error 1: Fault 2: Warning Raw 32765 = waiting, 32766 = unavailable, 32767 = unsupported.

ModbusCmd.Title: IR22 Unit abnormality code (raw)
ModbusCmd.HintText: Text16: 2 ASCII chars. High byte = INT(v/256), low byte = MOD(v;256). Example 21816 = 'U8'.

ModbusCmd.Title: IR23 Unit abnormality sub code
ModbusCmd.HintText: 32766 if no error, else 0..99
